Provision of Cleaning Services for Cedefop Premises

CEDEFOP/2026/OP/0012

Cedefop aims to sign a single framework contract for the provision of cleaning services for its premises in Thessaloniki Greece.  

The call  has been published in the Supplement to the Official Journal of the European Union on 24/07/2026: https://ted.europa.eu/en/notice/-/detail/514278-2026 

The procurement documents are available via the EU Funding & Tenders Portal: 

https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/tender-details/eb9cab08-3cd0-4ec2-9374-1e09e3462ab2-CN 

Requests for additional information/clarification should be received by 25/09/2026, 23:59 (UTC+03:00 Greek local time).  All questions and answers will be available in the above mentioned link.

Deadline for electronic reception of tenders via e-Submission: 05/10/2026, 15:59 (UTC+03:00 Greek local time).

Tenders will be opened in a virtual opening session on the date and time indicated under Section 5.1.12 of the contract notice and point 3.2 of the invitation to tender.
